verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST/JSON API and an official MCP server package, but no official client SDK in any language. A raw REST API is a developer building block, and an MCP server is a different capability, so neither earns credit for this story. No OpenAPI spec was found either, so there is no documented path to generated SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
